reserveReview.rationale: The official dashboard API captured at 2026-09-30T07:28:33Z reports $3,107,626.6069017975 of cross-chain USDC, $1,563,632.090567056 of cross-chain USDT, $10,961.72270614788 of Sonic USSD and $123.923568 of Ethereum USDe. These measured collateral rows reconcile to $4,682,344.343743001 across active Ethereum, Sonic and BNB Smart Chain. Ethereum crvUSD and USDG are explicit zero rows; the previously reviewed zero-capital BNB Smart Chain FDUSD slot is absent and contributes no exposure. New Ethereum rows were matched by exact underlying contract address to the tracked USDe, crvUSD and USDG identities. Zero-percent keyed rows retain reviewed identities for later positive balances without fabricating current exposure.
